visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven current portable views against individually viewed local 2006 northwest-gallery, 2009 overall-front and 2019 front-detail photographs, plus HABS measured plans and elevations. Flat parapeted roofs, rear ell, curved canopies, two open galleries and arched shutters remain distinct. Review corrected the northwest stair direction, its upper-deck/joist opening, and the flat-roof material.

Stucco, timber, painted iron, corrugated metal and roof membrane use five shared metric surfaces; glass is a sixth separate local material. mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all nineteen current lighting, quality and forced-detail views. Skyline retains the open galleries, flat roofs, rear ell and small roof structures. District restores arched openings and shutters; street restores stair, quoins and simplified ironwork; closeup restores louvers, column flutes, roof seams and hourglass/heart-derived railing. Synthetic neighbors are style fixtures. No physical-device performance measurement is claimed.
